When we posted our last video, so many of you reached out to us and asked us to make a video on the issue of balding. We hear you. 

As it turns out, about 25% of men start experiencing hair loss by the age of 21. By 35, that's 66% of men. And the psychological toll it takes on them is worth bringing awareness to. There's a few solutions out there floating in a sea of scams and false promises. And in this video, we're gonna take you through all of it.
